o: Výslech Forbese – Situace – Na výzvědách – Poměr zápasících sil – Zbytek ležení – Briant zmizel – Doniphan jemu na pomoc – Těžké zranění – Výkřik od French Cavern – Zjevení se Forbese – Mokův výstřel z děla.
t: The questioning of Forbes — The situation — On reconnoitering — The relative strength of the fighters — The rest of the night — Briant disappears — Doniphan goes to his aid — A severe wound — A shout from French Cavern — Forbes's appearance — Mok's cannon shot.

o: Ačkoliv tato noc beze spánku byla tak namáhavá, nikoho druhý den nenapadlo, aby si alespoň na hodinku odpočinul.
t: Although this sleepless night was so exhausting, it occurred to no one the next day to rest even for an hour.

o: Bylo v té chvíli zcela nepochybné, že Walston, když se mu nezdařila lest, se uchýlí k násilí.
t: At that moment it was quite certain that Walston, having failed in his trick, would resort to violence.

o: Rock, jenž unikl výstřelu kormidelníka, ho nepochybně opět vyhledal a sdělil mu, že nyní, kdy byly jeho úklady prozrazeny, pouze vylomením dveří bylo možné vniknout do French Cavern.
t: Rock, who had escaped the helmsman's shot, had undoubtedly sought him out again and told him that now, with his plans betrayed, the only way into French Cavern was by breaking down the door.

o: Již za ranních červánků vyšli opatrně ven Evans, Briant, Doniphan a Gordon.
t: Already at the first morning light Evans, Briant, Doniphan and Gordon cautiously went outside.

o: Po východu slunce houstly ranní mlhy stále více a vznesly se nad jezero, které čeřil slabý vánek.
t: After sunrise the morning mists grew thicker and thicker and rose above the lake, which a faint breeze rippled.

o: Celé okolí French Cavern, jak na straně k řece Zealand, tak na straně k Traps Woods, se zdálo být klidné.
t: The whole surroundings of French Cavern, on the side toward the River Zealand as well as on the side toward Traps Woods, seemed calm.

o: Uvnitř ohrady pobíhala domácí zvířata jako obyčejně sem a tam.
t: Inside the enclosure the domestic animals wandered about as usual, here and there.

o: Phann, jenž poskakoval po Sport Terrace, nedával najevo žádný nepokoj.
t: Phann, who was hopping about on Sport Terrace, showed no sign of uneasiness.

o: Evans především pátral, nejsou-li znát na zemi otisky nohou.
t: Evans chiefly searched the ground for footprints.

o: Skutečně jich objevil veliké množství, zejména v blízkosti French Cavern.
t: He indeed found a great many of them, especially near French Cavern.

o: Křížily se na všechny strany a byly důkazem, že Walston a jeho společníci se dostali až k řece a při otvoru dveří vedoucích do zásobárny naslouchali.
t: They crossed in all directions and were evidence that Walston and his companions had reached the river and had listened at the door leading to the storehouse.

o: Stopy krve na písku znát nebyly.
t: No traces of blood were to be seen in the sand.

o: To byl důkaz, že Rock nebyl kulkou kormidelníka zraněn.
t: That was proof that Rock had not been wounded by the helmsman's bullet.

o: Tu se však naskytla otázka, zda Walston, jako nepraví trosečníci, přišel od jihu Family Lake, nebo zda snad spíš nedorazil k French Cavern od severu.
t: But then the question arose whether Walston, as a false shipwrecked man, had come from the south of Family Lake, or whether perhaps he had not reached French Cavern from the north at all.

o: Ve druhém případě by musel Rock zcela jistě uprchnout k Traps Woods, aby se k němu opět připojil.
t: In the latter case Rock would certainly have had to flee to Traps Woods in order to join him again.

o: Bylo velice důležité vysvětlit tuto okolnost, a proto se dohodli, že podrobí Forbese výslechu, aby se dozvěděli, kterou cestu Walston nastoupil.
t: It was very important to explain this circumstance, and so they agreed that they would put Forbes under interrogation in order to learn which road Walston had taken.

o: Bylo však možné donutit Forbese k tomu, aby mluvil, a pokud by mluvil, pověděl by pravdu…?
t: But it was possible to force Forbes to speak, and if he did speak, he would tell the truth…?

o: Probudily by se v jeho srdci šlechetnější pocity z vděčnosti ke Caty, která mu zachránila život…?
t: Would the nobler feelings of gratitude to Caty, who had saved his life, awaken in his heart…?

o: Zapomene, co to znamená zradit ty, které dříve žádal o pohostinné přijetí ve French Cavern?
t: Would he forget what it means to betray those whom he had formerly asked for hospitality at French Cavern?

o: Aby jej osobně podrobil otázkám, vrátil se Evans do haly, otevřel dveře boční místnosti, do níž vsadil Forbese, zbavil jej pout a uvedl do haly.
t: In order to question him personally, Evans returned to the hall, opened the door of the side room into which he had put Forbes, released him from his bonds and brought him into the hall.

o: „Forbesi,“ začal Evans, „tvůj i Rockův úkladný záměr se nezdařil.
t: "Forbes," Evans began, "your cunning scheme as well as Rock's has failed.

o: Záleží mi na tom, abych se dozvěděl, jaké měl Walston nejdříve úmysly.
t: It matters to me to learn what Walston's first intentions were.

o: Ty o tom dobře víš.
t: You know that perfectly well.

o: Chceš mi odpovídat?“
t: Will you answer me?

o: Forbes sklonil hlavu a neodvážil se podívat do očí ani Evansovi, ani Caty, ani chlapcům, před které jej kormidelník předvedl. Mlčel.
t: Forbes bowed his head and did not dare look into the eyes of Evans, nor of Caty, nor of the boys before whom the helmsman had brought him. He was silent.

o: Caty se pokoušela být prostřednicí.
t: Caty tried to act as mediator.

o: „Forbesi,“ řekla, „dříve jste byl alespoň poněkud soucitnější, když jste své společníky při vraždění na Severnu zdržoval, aby mne nezabili.
t: "Forbes," she said, "you used to be at least somewhat more compassionate, when you held your companions back from the murder in the North so that they would not kill me.

o: Budete i nyní připraven učinit něco, aby tyto děti byly uchovány od daleko hroznějšího vraždění?“
t: Will you now be prepared to do something to keep these children from a far more terrible murder?"

o: Forbes neodpovídal.
t: Forbes did not answer.

o: „Forbesi,“ mluvila dál, „ty děti vám darovaly život, zatímco vy jste byl hoden smrti.
t: "Forbes," she went on, "these children gave you life, while you deserved death.

o: Zajisté ve vás ještě nadobro neutuchl pocit lidskosti.
t: Surely the feeling of humanity has not yet died out in you.

o: I když jste již spáchal tolik zlého, ještě se můžete vrátit na cestu dobra.
t: Even though you have already done so much evil, you can still return to the path of good.

o: Vzpomeňte, k jak ohavnému zločinu jste nyní podával pomocnou ruku!“
t: Remember to what a monstrous crime you are now lending a hand!"

o: Z Forbesových prsou se v té chvíli vydral napůl dušený vzdech.
t: From Forbes's breast there escaped at that moment a half-strangled sigh.

o: „Co mohu učinit?“ odpověděl temným hlasem.
t: "What can I do?" he answered in a dark voice.

o: „Můžeš nám sdělit,“ ujal se slova Evans, „co se mělo stát tuto noc a jaké byly další záměry vůči nám.
t: "You can tell us," Evans took up the words, "what was to have happened tonight, and what further intentions you had toward us.

o: Očekával jsi Walstona a ostatní, kteří sem chtěli vniknout, jakmile by jim byly jedny dveře otevřeny?“
t: Did you expect Walston and the others, who wanted to break in here, as soon as a door was opened to them?"

o: „Ano!“ zamumlal Forbes.
t: "Yes!" Forbes muttered.

o: „A tito chlapci, kteří tě tak přátelsky přijali, měli být všichni povražděni?“
t: "And these boys, who received you so kindly, were all to be murdered?"

o: Forbesova hlava padla na prsa a neměl sílu, aby odpověděl.
t: Forbes's head fell to his chest, and he had no strength to answer.

o: „Řekni nám,“ pravil kormidelník, „ze které strany sem přišli Walston a jeho společníci?“
t: "Tell us," said the helmsman, "from which side did Walston and his companions come here?"

o: „Od severu jezera,“ odpověděl Forbes.
t: "From the north of the lake," Forbes answered.

o: „Zatímco vy dva, Rock a ty, jste přišli od jihu?“
t: "But you two — Rock and you — came from the south?"

o: „Navštívili snad již na západě ostatní části ostrova?“
t: "Have you perhaps already visited the other parts of the island to the west?"

o: „Kde jsou asi nyní?“
t: "Where might they be now?"

o: „Nemůžeš nám říci více, Forbesi?“
t: "Can't you tell us more, Forbes?"

o: „Nikoliv… Evansi… nikoliv.“
t: "No... Evans... no."

o: „A myslíš si, že se sem Walston nevrátí?“
t: "And do you think Walston won't come back here?"

o: Walston a jeho společníci patrně, když zaslechli kormidelníkův výstřel a zjistili, že jejich lest byla prohlédnuta, pokládali za vhodné vydat se jinam a počkat na vhodnější příležitost.
t: Walston and his companions, having apparently heard the helmsman's shot and realized that their ruse had been seen through, considered it advisable to make off elsewhere and wait for a more favorable opportunity.

o: Evans, jenž nedoufal v bližší objasnění od Forbese, odvedl jej opět do jeho vězení, jehož dveře byly zvenčí uzamčeny.
t: Evans, who did not expect any closer explanation from Forbes, took him back to his cell, whose doors were locked on the outside.

o: Postavení všech bylo a zůstávalo velice napjaté.
t: The situation of everyone was, and remained, extremely tense.

o: Kde se Walston zdržoval?
t: Where was Walston keeping himself?

o: Byl snad skryt v Traps Woods?
t: Was he perhaps hidden in Traps Woods?

o: Forbes to buď nemohl, nebo nechtěl říci.
t: Forbes either could not or would not say.

o: A přece bylo tak nutné, aby měli v tomto směru jasno.
t: And yet it was so necessary that they should have clarity in this direction.

o: Z toho důvodu si kormidelník usmyslel, že ohledně toho něco podnikne, třebaže to bylo spojeno s nebezpečím.
t: For that reason the helmsman resolved to do something about it, even though it was attended with danger.

o: V poledne přinesl Moko zajatci něco k jídlu.
t: At noon Moko brought the prisoner something to eat.

o: Forbes seděl zamyšlen a sotva se potravy dotkl.
t: Forbes sat in a brooding mood and hardly touched the food.

o: Co se dělo v nešťastníkově duši?
t: What was going on in the unfortunate man's soul?

o: Trápilo jej snad svědomí…?
t: Was his conscience tormenting him...?

o: Kdo to mohl vědět?
t: Who could know?

o: Po snídani vyložil Evans chlapcům svůj úmysl, že se chce vydat až k okraji Traps Woods, protože mu velice záleží na tom, aby se dozvěděl, zda se zločinci dosud zdržovali v okolí French Cavern.
t: After breakfast Evans explained to the boys his intention of going as far as the edge of Traps Woods, because it mattered greatly to him to find out whether the criminals were still lurking in the vicinity of French Cavern.

o: Tento návrh byl bez dalšího jednání přijat a provedeny veškeré přípravy a ochranná zařízení, aby se zajistili vůči všem možnostem.
t: This proposal was accepted without further ado, and all preparations and protective devices were made to guard against every possibility.

o: Walston a jeho společníci se nacházeli v době, kdy byl Forbes zajat, pouze v síle šesti mužů, zatímco malá osada kromě Evanse a Caty se skládala z patnácti chlapců.
t: Walston and his companions found themselves at a time when Forbes was captured with only six men, while the small settlement, apart from Evans and Caty, consisted of fifteen boys.

o: Z tohoto počtu však museli být odečteni nejmenší, kteří se nemohli boje přímo účastnit.
t: From this number, however, the youngest had to be subtracted, as they could not take part in the fight directly.

o: Bylo dohodnuto, že po dobu výzvědné obchůzky kormidelníka měli Iverson, Jenkins, Dole a Costar s Caty, Moko a Jacques zůstat pod Baxterovou ochranou v hale.
t: It was agreed that during the scout's reconnaissance circuit, Iverson, Jenkins, Dole and Costar would remain with Caty, Moko and Jacques under Baxter's protection in the hall.

o: Naproti tomu velcí, a to Briant, Gordon, Doniphan, Cross, Service, Webb, Wilcox a Garnett měli provázet Evanse.
t: On the other hand, the older ones—namely Briant, Gordon, Doniphan, Cross, Service, Webb, Wilcox and Garnett—were to escort Evans.

o: Osm chlapců proti šesti mužům ve věku největší síly byl ovšem veliký nepoměr.
t: Eight boys against six men in the prime of their strength was, however, a great disproportion.

o: Každý z nich měl ovšem jako zbraň pušku a revolver, zatímco Walston měl pouze pět pušek pocházejících ze Severnu.
t: Each of them had a rifle and a revolver as a weapon, while Walston had only five rifles that came from the North.

o: Za takových okolností by chlapcům poskytl nejlepší vyhlídky boj na dálku, poněvadž Doniphan, Wilcox a Cross byli výbornými střelci, a proto byli oproti americkým námořníkům v převaze.
t: Under such circumstances, the best prospects for the boys would be fighting at a distance, since Doniphan, Wilcox and Cross were excellent shots and would therefore be at an advantage over the American sailors.

o: Kromě toho měli dostatek střeliva, zatímco Walston, jak pravil kormidelník, byl odkázán pouze na několik nábojů.
t: Besides, they had plenty of ammunition, while Walston, as the helmsman said, was reduced to a few cartridges.

o: Byly asi dvě hodiny odpoledne, když se sestavil malý šik pod vedením Evanse.
t: It was about two in the afternoon when the little column formed under Evans's command.

o: Baxter, Jacques, Moko, Caty a malí se vrátili ihned do French Cavern, kde byly dveře sice zavřeny, ale nikoliv zataraseny, aby pro případ mohli ihned poskytnout rychlé útočiště kormidelníkovi a ostatním.
t: Baxter, Jacques, Moko, Caty and the youngsters returned at once to French Cavern, where the door was indeed closed but not barred, so that in case of need they could immediately provide a quick refuge for the helmsman and the others.

o: Ostatně nebylo se čeho obávat ani z jihu, ani ze západu, neboť kdyby chtěl Walston zaútočit z těchto stran, musel by se nejdříve dostat do zálivu Seagulla a pak táhnout podél řeky Zealand, což ovšem vyžadovalo delší čas.
t: Moreover, there was nothing to fear from the south or the west either, for if Walston wanted to attack from those directions, he would first have to get into Seagulla Bay and then drag himself along the Zealand River, which would of course take a longer time.

o: Podle Forbesovy výpovědi odešel k západnímu břehu jezera a ani tuto část ostrova neznal.
t: According to Forbes's testimony, he went to the western shore of the lake and did not know that part of the island either.

o: Evans se tedy nemusel obávat žádného útoku zezadu, neboť nepřátelské síly mohly být vyhledány jen na severu.
t: Evans therefore need not fear any attack from behind, since the enemy forces could only be looked for in the north.

o: Chlapci a kormidelník postupovali podél břehu Auckland Hill co možná nejopatrněji.
t: The boys and the helmsman advanced along the shore of Auckland Hill as cautiously as possible.

o: Křoviny a skupiny stromů za výšinou jim dovolovaly dorazit do lesa, přičemž své postavení nijak neodkrývali.
t: The bushes and groups of trees behind the rise allowed them to reach the forest without revealing their position in any way.

o: Evans kráčel v čele a byl neustále nucen krotit Doniphanovu horlivost, který chtěl být stále první.
t: Evans walked in front and was constantly forced to rein in Doniphan's eagerness, who wanted to be first all the time.

o: Když se dostali k hrobu, jenž kryl tělesné ostatky francouzského trosečníka, pokládal kormidelník za vhodné dát se šikmo, aby se přiblížil k pobřeží Family Lake.
t: When they came to the grave that covered the remains of the French castaway, the helmsman deemed it fitting to turn aside so as to approach the shore of Family Lake.

o: Phann, jehož se Gordon marně snažil zadržet, zřejmě, stříhaje ušima a čenichaje nosem při zemi, něco větřil, a brzy zjistili, že našel stopu.
t: Phann, whom Gordon vainly tried to hold back, apparently scenting something with his ears and snuffing the ground with his nose, and soon they found that he had picked up a trail.

o: „Pozor!“ zvolal Briant.
t: "Look out!" cried Briant.

o: „Ano,“ odpověděl Gordon.
t: "Yes," Gordon answered.

o: „To není stopa zvěře.
t: "That's not an animal's track."

o: Pozorujte počínání psa!“
t: "Watch the dog's doings!"

o: „Vplížíme se pod křoviny,“ radil Evans, „a vy, Doniphane, protože dobře střílíte, ať neminete ani jednoho lotra, jakmile jej dostanete na mušku.
t: "We'll creep along under the bushes," advised Evans, "and you, Doniphan, since you shoot well, don't miss a single brigand once you have him in your sights.

o: Užitečnější kulku nikdy nevystřelíte.“
t: "You'll never fire a more useful bullet."

o: Za několik okamžiků se dostali k prvním skupinám stromů.
t: In a few moments they reached the first groups of trees.

o: Tam na pokraji Traps Woods našli stopy nedávného ležení, sotva zuhelnatělé větve a sotva vychladlý popel.
t: There, at the edge of Traps Woods, they found traces of a recent camp, branches barely scorched and ashes barely cold.

o: „Zcela jistě pobýval Walston minulou noc na tomto místě,“ připomenul Gordon.
t: "Walston was certainly here last night," Gordon reminded them.

o: „A možná že snad před několika hodinami byl ještě zde,“ odpověděl Evans.
t: "And maybe just a few hours ago he was still here," Evans answered.

o: „Pokládám proto za správnější, když poněkud ustoupíme ke skalnatému pobřeží.“
t: "I think it wiser, therefore, if we retreat a little toward the rocky shore."

o: Sotva dopověděl, když z pravé strany zahřměla rána.
t: He had barely finished speaking when a shot rang out from the right.

o: Kulka nesoucí se nad Briantovou hlavou se zaryla do stromu, o který se opíral.
t: The bullet, passing over Briant's head, buried itself in the tree against which he was leaning.

o: Téměř současně zahřměl ještě další výstřel, po němž následoval výkřik, zatímco asi o padesát kroků dál jakási postava zmizela pod stromy.
t: Almost simultaneously another shot rang out, followed by a shout, while some fifty paces away a figure vanished beneath the trees.

o: Byl to Doniphan, který vystřelil ve směru kouře první rány.
t: It was Doniphan, who had fired at the smoke of the first shot.

o: Protože pes nezůstal stát, pádil Doniphan bez rozmyslu za ním, rozohněný bojem.
t: Since the dog did not stay put, Doniphan recklessly galloped after him, roused by the fight.

o: „Kupředu!“ zvolal Evans, „nesmíme jej nechat samotného proti přesile!“
t: "Forward!" cried Evans, "we mustn't let him face the odds alone!"

o: Za několik minut dohonili Doniphana a kruhem se postavili kolem těla, které leželo uprostřed vysoké trávy.
t: In a few minutes they caught up with Doniphan and formed a circle around the body lying in the midst of the tall grass.

o: „Tento zde je Pike,“ řekl Evans.
t: "This one here is Pike," said Evans.

o: „Dostal svou odměnu, lotr.
t: "He got his reward, the brigand.

o: Kdyby ho sám ďábel chtěl dostat, musel by se vrátit s nepořízenou.
t: If the devil himself wanted to get him, he'd have to come back empty-handed.

o: „Ostatní asi nebudou daleko odtud,“ podotkl Garnett.
t: "The others probably aren't far from here," Garnett remarked.

o: „Nuže, mladí přátelé, dejme se do práce!“
t: "Well, young friends, let's get to work!"

o: „Na kolena! Na kolena!“
t: "On your knees! On your knees!"

o: Třetí výstřel, tentokrát z levé strany.
t: A third shot, this time from the left.

o: Service, jenž neshýbl hlavu, škrábla kulka na čele.
t: Service, who had not ducked his head, felt the bullet graze his forehead.

o: „Jsi raněn?“ zvolal Gordon a běžel k němu.
t: "Are you hit?" cried Gordon, running to him.

o: „To nic není, Gordone, docela nic,“ odpověděl Service.
t: "It's nothing, Gordon, nothing at all," Service answered.

o: „Nanejvýš lehká rána.“
t: "At the very worst a scratch."

o: Nyní záleželo na tom, aby se od sebe neoddělovali.
t: Now it was a matter of their not separating from one another.

o: Když byl Pike zabit, zbýval již jen Walston se čtyřmi muži, kteří asi nedaleko zaujali postavení za stromy.
t: With Pike killed, only Walston remained with the four men who had probably taken up a position not far off behind the trees.

o: Evans a jeho přátelé, skrčení pod křovím, se srazili do šiku, připraveni bránit se, kdyby z některé strany mělo dojít k útoku.
t: Evans and his friends, crouched in the bushes, closed into a line, ready to defend themselves should an attack come from any side.

o: Náhle zvolal Garnett.
t: Suddenly Garnett called out.

o: „Nevidím ho,“ odpověděl Wilcox.
t: "I don't see him," Wilcox answered.

o: Briant skutečně zmizel, a protože štěkot psa byl slyšet s novou prudkostí, obávali se, že statečný chlapec se dostal do zápasu s několika muži loupežné tlupy.
t: Briant had indeed vanished, and since the dog's barking was heard with renewed fierceness, they feared that the brave boy had got into a struggle with several men of the robber band.

o: „Briante! Briante!“ zvolal Doniphan.
t: "Briant! Briant!" cried Doniphan.

o: Všichni se pustili nevědomky po stopách Phanna.
t: All of them set off unknowingly in the track of Phann.

o: Evans je již nemohl zadržet.
t: Evans could no longer hold him back.

o: Plížili se od stromu ke stromu a neustále se blížili.
t: They crept from tree to tree, drawing continually nearer.

o: „Pozor, Evansi, pozor!“ zvolal náhle Cross, jenž rychle padl na zem.
t: "Look out, Evans, look out!" cried Cross suddenly, as he dropped quickly to the ground.

o: Jako v předtuše sklonil kormidelník hlavu, právě když několik palců nad ním zahvízdla kulka.
t: As if in a premonition, the helmsman bowed his head just as a bullet whizzed a few inches above him.

o: Když opět vstal, spatřil jednoho z Walstonovy tlupy, jenž prchal stromovím.
t: When he rose again, he saw one of Walston's gang fleeing through the woods.

o: Poznal Rocka, který mu minulou noc unikl.
t: He recognized Rock, who had escaped him the previous night.

o: „To je pro tebe, Rocku!“ zvolal.
t: "This one's for you, Rock!" he shouted.

o: Vystřelil a Rock zmizel, jako by se propadl do země.
t: He fired, and Rock vanished as if he had dropped through the earth.

o: „Copak jsem ho zase minul?“ zvolal Evans.
t: "Did I miss him again?" Evans called out.

o: „Tisíc hromů, to by byla smůla!“
t: "A thousand thunders, that would be a shame!"

o: To všechno se stalo v několika minutách.
t: All of this happened within a few minutes.

o: Náhle zazněl štěkot psa zcela nablízku a hned nato byl slyšet Doniphanův hlas.
t: Suddenly a dog's bark rang out very close by, and immediately Doniphan's voice could be heard.

o: „Jen se drž, Briante!
t: "Just hold on, Briant!"

o: Dobře se drž!“ zvolal.
t: "Hold on tight!" he shouted.

o: Evans a ostatní se pustili tím směrem a asi po dvaceti krocích spatřili Brianta, jak zápasil s Copem.
t: Evans and the others set off in that direction, and after about twenty paces they saw Briant struggling with Cope.

o: Ten lotr mrštil již chlapcem o zem a už jej chtěl probodnout svým nožem, když Doniphan, jenž přišel právě včas, aby odrazil ránu, se vrhl na Copa, nemaje ani čas, aby použil svůj revolver.
t: The scoundrel had already thrown the boy to the ground and was about to stab him with his knife, when Doniphan, who had arrived just in time to ward off the blow, threw himself upon Cope without even having time to draw his revolver.

o: Vtom se mu zaryl bídákův nůž do prsou…
t: At that moment the villain's knife sank into his breast…

o: Klesl, ani nevykřikl.
t: He fell without a cry.

o: Když Cope zpozoroval, že jej chtěli Evans, Garnett a Webb zaskočit, dal se na útěk směrem na východ.
t: When Cope saw that Evans, Garnett, and Webb were about to spring on him, he took to his heels, heading east.

o: Současně za ním vystřelili několik ran.
t: At the same time several shots were fired after him.

o: Zmizel a Phann se vrátil, neboť jej nemohl dostihnout.
t: He disappeared, and Phann turned back, for he could not overtake him.

o: Sotva se Briant pozdvihl, přistoupil k Doniphanovi, opřel mu hlavu a snažil se jej vzkřísit.
t: As soon as Briant had risen, he came up to Doniphan, laid his head against him, and tried to rouse him.

o: Evans a ostatní přiběhli hned k němu, jakmile opět nabili své pušky.
t: Evans and the others ran up to him as soon as they had reloaded their rifles.

o: Boj vyzníval zpočátku v neprospěch Walstona, neboť Pike byl zabit, Cope a Rock pak neschopní boje.
t: The fight at first went against Walston, for Pike was killed and Cope and Rock were then unable to fight.

o: Bohužel, Doniphan byl raněn do prsou, a jak se zdálo, smrtelně.
t: Unfortunately, Doniphan had been wounded in the chest, and it seemed, mortally.

o: Oči měl zavřené, obličej bledý jako vosk, ani se nepohnul a ani neslyšel, že na něj Briant volal.
t: His eyes were closed, his face pale as wax; he did not stir, nor did he hear Briant calling to him.

o: Zatím se Evans sklonil nad chlapcovým tělem.
t: Meanwhile Evans bent over the boy's body.

o: Rozepnul mu vestu, pak roztrhl jeho zakrvácenou košili.
t: He opened his vest, then tore apart his bloodstained shirt.

o: Z úzké trojhranné rány nad čtvrtým žebrem na levé straně se dosud řinula krev.
t: From a narrow triangular wound above the fourth rib on the left side, blood was still flowing.

o: Zasáhlo ostří nože srdce?
t: Had the knife's edge struck his heart?

o: Nikoliv, neboť Doniphan dosud dýchal.
t: No, for Doniphan was still breathing.

o: Avšak byla obava, že byly zasaženy plíce, neboť dech raněného byl neobyčejně slabý.
t: Yet there was fear that his lungs had been hit, for the wounded boy's breath was extraordinarily weak.

o: „Dopravme ho do French Cavern!“ řekl Gordon.
t: "Let's take him to French Cavern!" said Gordon.

o: „Pouze tam můžeme o něj pečovat.“
t: "Only there can we care for him."

o: „A zachránit jej!“ zvolal Briant.
t: "And save him!" cried Briant.

o: „Ach, můj ubohý příteli!
t: "Ah, my poor friend!

o: Za mne ses obětoval!“
t: You have sacrificed yourself for me!"

o: Evans schválil návrh odnést Doniphana ihned do French Cavern – zvláště když se zdálo, že v boji nastala chvíle klidu.
t: Evans approved the proposal to carry Doniphan to French Cavern at once — especially since it seemed that a lull had fallen in the fighting.

o: Bylo pravděpodobné, že když Walston viděl svůj nezdar, uprchl do hlubin Traps Woods.
t: It was likely that Walston, seeing his failure, had fled into the depths of Traps Woods.

o: Avšak – a to Evanse nejvíc znepokojovalo – nespatřil ani Walstona, ani Brandta, ani Rocka, a ti byli nejnebezpečnější z celé tlupy.
t: Yet — and this worried Evans most — he had seen neither Walston, nor Brandt, nor Rock, and they were the most dangerous of the whole band.

o: Doniphanův stav vyžadoval, aby byl bez prodlení odnesen.
t: Doniphan's condition required that he be carried away without delay.

o: Briant a Service se snažili rychle zhotovit nosítka z větví – na ta byl chlapec položen, avšak vědomí se mu nevrátilo.
t: Briant and Service hurried to make a stretcher from branches — the boy was laid upon it, but he did not regain consciousness.

o: Pak jej pomalu jeho čtyři přátelé zdvihli, zatímco ostatní je obklopili, majíce pušky nabité a revolvery v rukou.
t: Then his four friends slowly lifted him, while the others surrounded them, rifles loaded and revolvers in hand.

o: Průvod se dal přímo podél úpatí Auckland Hill.
t: The procession set out directly along the foot of Auckland Hill.

o: Bylo to lepší než pustit se po břehu jezera.
t: It was better than following the shore of the lake.

o: Podél vysočiny museli dávat pozor nalevo a dozadu.
t: Along the ridge they had to watch to the left and behind them.

o: Avšak nic je nerušilo na této smutné cestě.
t: Yet nothing disturbed them on this sad journey.

o: Několikrát zavzdychal Doniphan tak bolestně, že Gordon poručil zastavit, aby pozoroval jeho dech, a za chvíli se dali opět na cestu.
t: Several times Doniphan sighed so painfully that Gordon ordered a halt to observe his breathing, and after a moment they set out on their way again.

o: Takto ušli tři čtvrtiny cesty.
t: Thus they covered three quarters of the way.

o: Zbývalo jen učinit ještě osm nebo devět set kroků, aby dorazili do French Cavern, jehož dveře dosud nebyly vidět, neboť byly skryté za výběžkem pobřežního pohoří.
t: Only eight or nine hundred steps remained to reach French Cavern, whose doors they had not yet seen, for they were hidden behind an outlying spur of the coastal hills.

o: Tu se ozvaly od řeky Zealand výkřiky.
t: Then shouts were heard from the river Zealand.

o: Phann vyrazil tím směrem.
t: Phann rushed off in that direction.

o: Bylo zjevné, že Walston přepadl s dvěma společníky French Cavern.
t: It was evident that Walston had fallen upon French Cavern with two companions.

o: Skutečně – jak později zjistili – přihodilo se následující.
t: Indeed — as they learned later — the following happened.

o: Zatímco Rock, Cope a Pike dobře ukryti za silnými stromy Traps Woods zaměstnávali malou Evansovu družinu, dorazili jejich společníci Walston, Brandt a Book k Auckland Hill a pustili se vyschlým korytem Dike Creeku.
t: While Rock, Cope and Pike, well hidden behind the thick trees of Traps Woods, were occupying the little Evans party, their companions Walston, Brandt and Book reached Auckland Hill and set off along the dry bed of Dike Creek.

o: Přeběhli rychle jeho náhorní plošinu a slezli průrvou ke břehu řeky poblíž vchodu do zásobárny.
t: They quickly crossed its upland plateau and descended through a ravine to the riverbank near the entrance to the storehouse.

o: Jakmile tam jednou byli, podařilo se jim prolomit dveře, které nebyly zataraseny, a vnikli do French Cavern.
t: Once there, they managed to break through the doors, which were not barred, and entered French Cavern.

o: Přijde Evans ještě včas, aby zabránil pohromě?
t: Will Evans still arrive in time to prevent the disaster?

o: Vmžiku si kormidelník sestavil plán.
t: In an instant the helmsman formed a plan.

o: Zatímco Cross, Webb a Garnett zůstali u Doniphana, kterého nemohli zanechat o samotě, dali se Gordon, Briant, Service, Wilcox a on do běhu co nejkratším směrem ke French Cavern.
t: While Cross, Webb and Garnett remained with Doniphan, whom they could not leave alone, Gordon, Briant, Service, Wilcox and he set off running by the shortest route to French Cavern.

o: O několik minut později, když spatřili Sport Terrace, naskytla se jim podívaná, která je zbavovala veškeré naděje.
t: A few minutes later, when they sighted Sport Terrace, a sight presented itself that stripped them of all hope.

o: V téže chvíli vystoupil Walston ze dveří haly a držel dítě, které táhl k řece.
t: At that same moment Walston came out of the hall doors holding a child whom he was dragging toward the river.

o: Tento chlapec byl Jacques.
t: The boy was Jacques.

o: Marně se mu jej snažila Caty vyrvat, když se vrhla na Walstona.
t: In vain did Caty try to tear the child from him as she threw herself upon Walston.

o: Okamžik nato se objevil Walstonův společník.
t: At that moment Walston's partner appeared.

o: Brandt uchopil malého Costara a unášel ho stejným směrem.
t: Brandt seized the little Costa and carried him off in the same direction.

o: Baxter se sice na Brandta vrhl, byl však prudce odstrčen a svalil se na zem.
t: Baxter did rush at Brandt, but he was shoved aside sharply and fell to the ground.

o: Ostatní děti, Dole, Jenkins a Iverson, nebyly k spatření, dokonce ani sám Moko.
t: The other children, Dole, Jenkins and Iverson, were nowhere to be seen, not even Moko himself.

o: Snad již byly zavražděny uvnitř French Cavern.
t: Perhaps they had already been murdered inside French Cavern.

o: Zatím se Walston a Brandt přiblížili rychle k řece.
t: Meanwhile Walston and Brandt approached the river quickly.

o: Bylo snad možné dostat se přes ni jinak než plaváním?
t: Was it perhaps possible to get across it in some way other than swimming?

o: Ano, neboť tam byl Book, a sice v jole, kterou vytáhl ze zásobárny.
t: Yes, for Book was there, in a canoe he had hauled out of the storehouse.

o: Jakmile by jednou byli na levém břehu, byli by všichni tři v bezpečí.
t: Once they were on the left bank, all three would be safe.

o: Dříve než jim někdo mohl zamezit cestu, vydali by se do svého ležení v Bear Rock – Jacquese a Costara měli v rukou jako rukojmí.
t: Before anyone could bar their way, they would set off for their lair at Bear Rock—with Jacques and Costa as their hostages in hand.

o: Evans, Briant, Gordon, Cross a Wilcox běželi, co jim nohy stačily, doufajíce, že dorazí na Sport Terrace dříve, než by se Walston, Book a Brandt dostali na druhý břeh.
t: Evans, Briant, Gordon, Cross and Wilcox ran as fast as their legs would carry them, hoping to reach Sport Terrace before Walston, Book and Brandt got to the far bank.

o: Kdyby na ně stříleli ze vzdálenosti, kde se nacházeli, mohli by zároveň zastřelit i Jacquese a Costara.
t: If they shot at them from where they stood, they might shoot Jacques and Costa as well.

o: Byl zde však Phann.
t: But Phann was there.

o: Vrhl se na Brandta a zakousl se mu do šíje.
t: He threw himself at Brandt and sank his teeth into the back of his neck.

o: Zločinec, aby se mohl lépe bránit psovi, pustil Costara, zatímco Walston se snažil odvléci Jacquese do joly.
t: The villain, in order to defend himself better against the dog, let go of Costa, while Walston tried to drag Jacques into the canoe.

o: Náhle vyběhl z haly muž. Byl to Forbes.
t: Suddenly a man ran out of the hall. It was Forbes.

o: Chtěl se snad spojit se svými starými společníky, zločinci, když vyrazil dveře svého vězení?
t: Was he perhaps trying to join his old partners, the criminals, as he burst out the door of his cell?

o: Walston o tom nepochyboval.
t: Walston had no doubt about it.

o: „Za mnou, Forbesi…!
t: "After me, Forbes...!"

o: Pojď…! Pojď!“ volal.
t: "Come on...! Come on!" he called.

o: Evans se zastavil a již chtěl vypálit ránu, když viděl, jak se Forbes vrhl na Walstona.
t: Evans stopped and was about to fire when he saw Forbes rush at Walston.

o: Walston překvapen tímto útokem, kterého se nenadál, musel pustit Jacquese a obrátil se s nožem proti Forbesovi.
t: Walston, surprised by this unexpected attack, had to release Jacques and turn with his knife against Forbes.

o: Forbes klesl u Walstonových nohou.
t: Forbes fell at Walston's feet.

o: To všechno se stalo v okamžiku.
t: All of this happened in a moment.

o: Evans, Briant, Gordon, Service a Wilcox byli ještě asi sto kroků od Sport Terrace.
t: Evans, Briant, Gordon, Service and Wilcox were still about a hundred paces from Sport Terrace.

o: Vtom chtěl Walston znovu uchopit Jacquese, aby jej vtáhl do joly, kde jej očekával Book a Brandt, jemuž se podařilo zbavit se psa.
t: Then Walston wanted to seize Jacques again, to drag him into the jolly boat, where Book and Brandt were waiting for him, Brandt having succeeded in shaking off the dog.

o: Nepodařilo se mu to.
t: He did not succeed.

o: Jacques, jenž byl ozbrojen revolverem, vystřelil do jeho prsou.
t: Jacques, who was armed with a revolver, fired into his chest.

o: Walston, těžce raněn, měl ještě sílu potácet se ke svým dvěma společníkům, kteří jej uchopili do náručí a odrazili od břehu, když prudce odstrčili jolu.
t: Walston, badly wounded, still had the strength to stagger toward his two companions, who caught him in their arms and pushed him away from the bank as they shoved the jolly boat off.

o: V té chvíli zaduněla hromová rána.
t: At that moment a thunderclap boomed.

o: Krupobití kulek rozbrázdilo vody řeky.
t: A hail of bullets churned the waters of the river.

o: Bylo to z malého děla, jež vypálil plavčík střílnou zásobárny.
t: It was from a small gun fired by the powder magazine's mate.

o: A v té chvíli, kromě dvou zločinců, kteří zmizeli v hloubi Traps Woods, byl Chairman Island zbaven lupičů Severnu, které odnášel proud řeky Zealand k oceánu.
t: And at that moment, besides the two criminals who vanished into the depths of Traps Woods, Chairman Island was rid of the brigands of Severn, whom the current of the Zealand River was carrying to the ocean.
